regime_context: Detector shows narrow leadership concentrated in AI Compute & Optics and Semiconductors, with only 6 of 22 themes eligible per the absolute-trend gate. The gate never reduced drawdown on this market historically (mean-reverting tape whipsaws the gate), and cross-sectional momentum has no validated edge, so the state is a focus lens only. Macro backdrop is AI-dominated with high unscheduled news share, further undermining directional conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff from AI Compute to Semiconductors. Kill-criterion: if after 10 trading days AI Compute maintains a margin >0.30 over Semiconductors and the eligible count stays ≤6, the rotation fails to confirm.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: Leader with robust eligibility, trend persistence (durability 0.55), and no crowding. The trend gate signals 'eligible', suggesting the theme is in an absolute uptrend; staying allocated while the trend holds is a discipline, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Historically, trend-following in China A-shares has been whipsawed; the gate's failure to reduce drawdown here means this eligibility signal may not persist and could reverse sharply.

falsifier.text: AI Compute & Optics loses eligibility (trend gate deems it ineligible) or its durability bar falls below 0.40 at any close.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Strong challenger with high durability (0.70), broad participation (breadth 0.409), and no crowding. The trend gate confirms an active uptrend, justifying a continued overweight stance while that holds.
theses.dissent: Momentum rank-IC is ~0; the high durability could be coincident with a topping pattern, and the theme may stall as the gate historically fails to capture meaningful trends.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors becomes ineligible per the trend gate or durability bar drops below 0.50.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Eligible and trending with the highest durability (0.88) among scored themes, but crowding (z=1.23) calls for sizing-down, not fading. The trend discipline supports staying exposed with caution.
theses.dissent: Crowding often precedes sharp reversals; the trend gate has no edge here, so the position may suffer a mean-reverting drawdown despite high durability.

falsifier.text: Innovative Pharma & CXO loses eligibility or its crowding z-score exceeds 2.0 (extreme), prompting a size-down that effectively exits until normalized.
